name: Bug Fix - Comfort Bar
summary: Bug Fix - Vehicle window shows false wear on a train's Comfort bar: counts only parts with seats
description:
Bug Fix - Vehicle window shows false wear on a train's Comfort bar. Open a passenger train's window and expand its vehicle info under Condition: the Comfort bar of a locomotive-hauled train shows a large red part and a poor rating, even when the train is brand new or in Very Good condition. Red on these bars is meant to show what a vehicle has lost to wear. The window takes the train's comfort as that of its least comfortable coach, but works out the comfort after wear as an average over every part of the train, the locomotive included, which has no seats and so counts as zero. A locomotive with one coach shows half the coach's comfort, often 'Very Poor'.

With this mod the Comfort bar counts only the parts with seats, each after its own wear, so the locomotive no longer drags it down. A train in good condition shows its full comfort with no red part, and red appears only for comfort really lost to wear (with the vehicle maintenance effect option on) or to a comfort modifier. Speed, noise, pollution and every other figure stay as the game shows them. Only the display is changed: how comfortable passengers find the train is worked out by the game itself and stays as it is. The mod saves nothing with your game, so it can be removed at any time, for example once the game itself is fixed.

The fix can be turned off in the mod's Settings (the gear next to the mod when choosing a game's mods). Settings also has a Logging switch, off by default, that writes the mod's messages to the game log (stdout.txt) for bug reports.
